title: SS-BERT: MITIGATING IDENTITY TERMS BIAS IN TOXIC COMMENT CLASSIFICATION BY UTILISING THE NOTION OF “SUBJECTIVITY” AND “IDENTITY TERMS”
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating bias against identity groups in NLP models. A significant portion of the identity terms used for benchmarking and evaluation are religious in nature (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Islam', 'Allah', 'Jewish', and 'religion'). The study evaluates the model's performance on these terms to ensure ethical outcomes and reduce false positive bias.
